text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day during lunch break, as I was about 
to have lunch in the trainer's office...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
If this place is no good either, does that 
leave behind the gym...?
choice_data_list: Isn't there anything I can do?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...If that's the case, leave me alone.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
The classroom, the courtyard, the 
rooftop... Everywhere is packed with 
people and so noisy, I can't take it...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thinking we might as well, we tried 
heading over to a café, but—
